name: myschool
description: MySchool - A testbed application for MySchools App

scripts.build:functions: NODE_ENV=production npm run build && npm run prepare:functions
scripts.prepare:functions: npm run copy-next && npm run copy-src && npm run copy-config && npm run compile-functions && npm run install-deps
scripts.compile-functions: cd functions && npm ci && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.copy-next: rm -rf functions/.next && cp -rL .next functions/.next && rm -rf functions/.next/cache
scripts.copy-src: rm -rf functions/src/app functions/src/components functions/src/lib functions/src/middleware functions/src/middleware.ts && mkdir -p functions/src && cp -rL src/app functions/src/ && cp -rL src/components functions/src/ && cp -rL src/lib functions/src/ && if [ -d src/middleware ]; then cp -rL src/middleware functions/src/; fi && if [ -f src/middleware.ts ]; then cp -L src/middleware.ts functions/src/; fi
scripts.copy-config: cp next.config.js functions/ && cp tsconfig.json functions/tsconfig-parent.json
scripts.install-deps: cd functions && NODE_ENV=production npm ci --production && cd .. && npm run cleanup-deps
scripts.cleanup-deps: find functions/node_modules/next/dist -name '*.map' -delete && rm -rf functions/node_modules/next/dist/bin functions/node_modules/next/dist/cli functions/node_modules/next/dist/build/swc/nft-bindings functions/node_modules/@next/swc-* || true
scripts.emulators:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:start --only functions,hosting
scripts.check-size: du -sh functions/ && du -sh functions/.next && du -sh functions/node_modules

author: MySchools App Team
